build_ray_distributed_executor: build a Ray-based distributed executor for vLLM that initializes workers and runs model inference across multiple GPUs
execute_ray_distributed_model: execute a compiled Ray DAG on distributed workers with scheduler and grammar output for model inference
collective_rpc_ray_workers: run a method on all Ray workers synchronously or asynchronously with optional arguments and timeout
build_compiled_ray_dag: build a compiled Ray DAG with pipeline parallel stages and tensor transport for distributed model execution
reinitialize_ray_distributed: reinitialize distributed Ray workers with a reconfiguration request including rank changes and shutdown
